writer.name: 伊万·雅各布斯 Evan Jacobs

director.name: 伊万·雅各布斯 Evan Jacobs

introduction: A sad-sack professor (Chris Lohman) embarks on the adventure of a lifetime when he gets sucked into a satanic garbage dumpster. Upon moving into a new apartment during his divorce, the professor notices strange goings-on with the dumpster outside. It appears to be killing people. He quickly investigates and gets pulled into the dumpster himself. Soon, he's attacked by all manner of trash, realizing the dumpster is a literal, never-ending void. Along the way, he meets another man also held captive by this nefarious waste receptacle. In the end, after trying every means to escape, it becomes clear that our erstwhile professor must battle the evil spirit overlord, Trashula, who rules over the dumpster realm with a mighty grip.
